# Limpieza de la base de datos de CalCofi

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)

bottle_tbl <- read_csv(
  here("data","Bottle.csv"),
  locale = locale(encoding = "Windows-1252"),
  col_types = cols(
    DIC2 = col_character(),
    TA2  = col_character(),
    pH1  = col_character(),
    pH2  = col_character(),
    `DIC Quality Comment` = col_character(),
    .default = col_guess()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
) |>
  clean_names(replace = c("\u00b5" = "u"))

bottle_tbl
```
